name: MoveEmailToFolder
description: Moves an email message to a specified folder within a mailbox using Microsoft Graph.
author: @rahmat

fields.name: MailboxAddress
fields.label: Mailbox Address
fields.description: The email address of the mailbox containing the email to move.

fields.name: MessageId
fields.label: Message ID
fields.description: The unique identifier of the email message to move.

fields.name: FolderName
fields.label: Target Folder Name
fields.description: The display name of the destination folder where the email should be moved. The folder must already exist in the mailbox.

fields.name: Result
fields.label: Result
fields.description: The result of the email move operation, including success status and any error messages.
